summary: F7 clears the round-2 bar: rulings.md is the operator's decision input at the P5 pause, which comes right after this merge. Its lean, (a), leaves out that P8's guide-conformant AaC/PipelinesDeploy producer would name aac_tools under templates:. podYaml throws on that name (podYaml.groovy:37-39, verified), so V14's required-green first build fails and the P11 and ArgoCDDeploy pushes are held. Ruling on the page as written leads to a broken flow and an unplanned mid-run decision that runs into V19. The close-out report cannot prevent that, because the operator reads it only after ruling. The fix is one correction on the page. F8 is advisory and already recorded as close-out P9, so this round does not cover it.
